title: What happened in AI — Jun 20, 2026
intro: Today's feed spotlights Apple's launch of Core AI, a framework succeeding Core ML designed for Apple-Silicon optimized on-device generative AI. On the enterprise front, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 on Amazon Bedrock introduces data-sharing requirements that may impact compliance plans.

Meanwhile, open-source agent tooling saw significant activity, highlighted by the release of Persona.js for framework-free WebMCP interfaces and Cordium for secret-shielded Kubernetes sandboxes, showing a strong focus on secure, local, and web-native agent ecosystems.
highlights: Apple announced Core AI at WWDC 26, succeeding Core ML to run generative models locally and optimized for Apple Silicon.
Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 on Bedrock now requires opting into inference data sharing for retention and human review.
Developers open-sourced Persona.js, a framework-free vanilla-JS agent UI library featuring native WebMCP support.
Anthropic released claude-code v2.1.185 and claude-agent-sdk-python v0.2.106 with updated API stream stall handling.
New utility tools surfaced, including Cordium (a secure K8s agent sandbox) and Logslim (compressing build output for agents).
